title: Proof Plan for the Main Epipelagic Theorem
body_html:
Proof Plan for the Main Epipelagic Theorem

  1. Use Pan's minimal \(K\)-type input to show that any nonzero theta correspondence gives a residual vector satisfying the double moment-map condition.
  2. Use jump parity to restrict to the listed dual-pair ranks and residual lattice positions.
  3. Use the residual exact sequence splitting to identify the relevant lattice-model subspace with functions on the residual moment-map fiber.
  4. Use the residual fiber stabilizer lemma to decompose functions on \(X_{\lambda,\lambda'}\) into stabilizer characters.
  5. In the non-exceptional cases, the stabilizer graph gives the character formula \(\chi'\!=\chi^\ast ∘ \alpha\).
  6. In the exceptional unitary case, retain only characters trivial on the additional stabilizer.
  7. For the converse, combine the necessary moment-map condition with epipelagic data equivalence and uniqueness of theta lift.

deps.title: Residual Moment Fiber and Stabilizer Homomorphism
